latest.firm: Andersen Windows, Inc., of Bayport, Minnesota
latest.what: Andersen Windows Recalls Window Opening Control Devices Sold as Kits or Installed on 100 Series Casement Windows Due to Fall and Serious Injury Hazards
latest.why: The window opening control devices can break or detach after accidental or other impact, allowing the window to be opened, posing fall and serious injury hazards.
latest.units: About 91,000 (In addition, about 180 were sold in Canada)
